about:
# As The Crow Flies

💾 **[As The Crow Flies on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/as-the-crow-flies)**

A compact navigation island that helps you find NPCs and saved places, compare walking and flight estimates, and follow directions across Azeroth.

- Search by NPC name or role, with filters for services, classes and professions.
- Compare walking and flight routes by distance or estimated travel time, using your discovered flight points.
- Compass guidance, world-map destination pins and flight paths, and minimap markers.
- Per-character profiles, Modern and WoW Forever themes, customizable fonts and colors, and a resizable panel that tucks to either screen edge.

For World of Warcraft: Forever. Travel times are estimates; ground directions are compass bearings. Movement and flight selection stay manual.

![atcf-new](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a60f82a6-b24d-41b3-8ea6-37a4a3deea7d)

## Installation

Copy the `AsTheCrowFlies` folder into your Forever client's `Interface/AddOns` directory, then restart WoW. The folder should contain `AsTheCrowFlies.toc` directly. NPC search requires Forever QuestieDB (contract 3).

Type `/atcf` for settings or `/atcf show` to open the panel. Search in To, click Find routes, then Go on a route to start directions. Use `/atcf stop` to stop, or `/atcf remember My place` to save your current location. You can also assign “Expand / collapse navigation” in WoW's Keybindings.

## Contributing

Open an issue first. Include your Forever build and a reproducible route or UI problem.

## Development

In a source checkout, install the test runtime with `python -m pip install --target .work/pydeps lupa==2.8`, then run `python tests/run.py`, `python tests/release_test.py`, and `python tests/package_test.py --source-only` from the repository root. Build a release ZIP with `python tools/package.py --release`; output is written to `dist/`.

See [behavior details](https://github.com/elithrar/AsTheCrowFlies/blob/main/docs/BEHAVIOR.md), [data coverage](https://github.com/elithrar/AsTheCrowFlies/blob/main/docs/COVERAGE.md), [validation coverage](https://github.com/elithrar/AsTheCrowFlies/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md), and [release instructions](https://github.com/elithrar/AsTheCrowFlies/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md).

AsTheCrowFlies 0.2.4 for WoW Forever.

releases.name: AsTheCrowFlies v0.2.3
releases.notes:
# AsTheCrowFlies 0.2.3

- Bundle SomethingNeedDoing 0.5.3, including responsive settings rows/tabs, options cleanup recovery and preservation of Blizzard's slash-command registry.
- Cancel navigation-panel movement on same-profile switches and copies, even when every setting is unchanged. Old drag-stop callbacks cannot overwrite the replacement placement.
- Discard stale color edits, dropdown selections and profile confirmations; recover screen containment after an options window is hidden during a drag.
- Preserve flight data, navigation, character discovery/timings and the existing profile schemas.

Validated with Lua 5.1 model/runtime suites, equal-value gesture regressions, release guards and source-only package checks. Native rendering, physical input, combat/taint, real taxi journeys and coexistence remain unobserved in-game checks.

releases.name: AsTheCrowFlies v0.2.2
releases.notes:
# AsTheCrowFlies 0.2.2

- Explicitly enable mouse input for shared options tabs and controls.
- Align Background and Text color labels with other settings and display saved colors as clickable swatches.
- Bundle SomethingNeedDoing 0.4.3; retain native picker acceptance/cancellation, profiles and navigation behavior.

Validated with automated runtime, layout and packaging checks; native input and rendering remain pending in-game verification.

releases.name: AsTheCrowFlies v0.2.1
releases.notes:
# AsTheCrowFlies 0.2.1

- Compact options rows place labels beside controls and remove duplicate page headings.
- Use consistent themed dropdowns, checkboxes, numeric fields, sliders and scrollbars from SomethingNeedDoing 0.4.2.
- Make the active settings tab clear, preserve slider drags during refresh, and stack profile actions in narrow windows.

Validation covers model/runtime, fonts, profiles, scrolling, release guards and packaging. Native rendering and input still need in-game verification.
